title: This AI Stock Could Offer Life-Changing Gains
title_zh: 这只人工智能股票可以带来改变生活的收益
summary: The stock has climbed more than 120% over the past year.
summary_zh: 该股过去一年上涨了120%以上。

title: Nvidia and OpenAI abandon unfinished $100bn deal in favour of $30bn investment
title_zh: Nvidia 和 OpenAI 放弃未完成的 1000 亿美元交易，转而投资 300 亿美元
summary: Nvidia is close to finalising a $30bn investment into OpenAI that will replace the long-term $100bn commitment agreed by the companies last year...
summary_zh: Nvidia 即将敲定对 OpenAI 的 300 亿美元投资，这将取代两家公司去年商定的 1000 亿美元长期承诺……

title: As Microsoft Extends 20% OpenAI Deal, Is the Bull Case for MSFT Stronger Here?
title_zh: 随着微软延长 20% 的 OpenAI 协议，微软的看涨理由是否更强？
summary: With Microsoft’s OpenAI revenue arrangement now extended through 2032, should investors see this as fresh fuel for the MSFT bull story?
summary_zh: 随着微软的 OpenAI 收入安排现已延长至 2032 年，投资者是否应该将其视为 MSFT 牛市故事的新动力？

title: Walmart earnings beat estimates, but company offers cautious outlook amid 'somewhat unstable' backdrop
title_zh: 沃尔玛盈利超出预期，但在“有些不稳定”的背景下，公司对前景持谨慎态度
summary: Walmart reported results for its fiscal fourth quarter but chose to offer more conservative guidance for the year ahead.
summary_zh: 沃尔玛报告了第四财季的业绩，但选择为未来一年提供更为保守的指引。

title: The Buyout Case for Salesforce Is Real, but Marc Benioff Stands in the Way
title_zh: Salesforce 的收购案例是真实的，但马克·贝尼奥夫阻碍了
summary: Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) stock has shed almost 30% year-to-date, closing at $184.29 on February 17, 2026, down sharply from the $264.91 year-end close. That discount raises a question investors rarely ask about dominant software franchises: could Salesforce go private?
summary_zh: Salesforce（纽约证券交易所股票代码：CRM）股价今年迄今已下跌近 30%，2026 年 2 月 17 日收于 184.29 美元，较年末收盘价 264.91 美元大幅下跌。这种折扣引发了投资者很少询问主导软件特许经营权的一个问题：Salesforce 可以私有化吗？
